recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier horizontal composition featuring a central sepia-toned urban portrait framed by thick tan borders. The top section contains bold, ultra-extended typography, while the middle section utilizes a gritty, handwritten script overlaying a textured off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between rigid geometric headers and organic handwritten subtext
Tonal harmony between the tan borders and the sepia-toned photography
Balance of large negative space in the upper half against dense photographic detail in the lower half
coreInvariants: Heavy tan horizontal bars as framing devices

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a close-up portrait positioned in the lower half, slightly off-center to the left, looking directly at the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ultra-bold black text in the top tan bar acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starts at the bold header, moves to the handwritten script in the white space, and settles on the photographic subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant off-white negative space in the upper-middle section to provide breathing room for the script.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/Cream for the central negative space.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Black for primary typography and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast sepia tones in the image; flat, matte colors in the graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-extended geometric sans-serif and aggressive gestural script.
letterConstructionRules: Header: Extreme horizontal expansion, minimal kerning, thick uniform strokes.
Subtext: Rapid, dry-brush handwritten style with varying baseline and sharp angles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: O characters in header are wide ovals
L characters have very short vertical stems relative to their width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between industrial geometric forms and raw human gesture.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide geometric feel of the header.
Captures the raw, street-style energy of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-part horizontal layout. Top and bottom bands are solid tan (#C5A06B). The middle-top section is a textured off-white paper. The middle-bottom section is a sepia-toned, high-contrast urban photograph of a man in a hat standing in front of a city storefront with a car parked nearby.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-extended black sans-serif text centered in the top tan band. Add black handwritten marker-style text centered in the off-white section.

verificationChecks: Is the header text extremely wide?
Are the tan bars consistent in color and thickness?
Is the script text centered in the white space?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the tan bars.
Check that the sepia photo has deep blacks and warm midtones.
Verify the handwritten script looks like ink on paper, not a digital font.
Confirm the overall layout maintains a 1:1 square aspect ratio.
recipe.reuseFormula: Horizontal Trisection + Sepia Urban Photo + Ultra-Extended Header + Marker Script Overlay
